title: Free Image Enhancer: Natural 4K Upscale
description: Upscale photos to 4K with a Natural pro mode that removes noise and compression blocks and keeps faces, colours and text. Free, daily limit, nothing stored.
keywords: image enhancer, upscale image to 4k, upscale image to 8k, sharpen blurry photo, increase image resolution, photo sharpener online, enlarge image without losing quality
h1: Image Enhancer: Natural 4K Photos, Cleaner and Sharper
intro: Upload a soft, noisy or small photo and get a larger, cleaner copy at 2K, 4K or 8K size. The Natural pro mode removes grain and compression blocks, improves light and contrast a little, and keeps your picture exactly as it is: same faces, colours, background, text and shape.
how: Sign in (it is free) and choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
Keep Natural pro (recommended) and pick the size: 2K, 4K (3840 px on the long edge) or 8K.
Choose the strength, and whether to remove noise and improve light and contrast.
Press Enhance, compare before and after with the slider, then download the result.
honest: How it works, honestly: Natural pro first cleans noise and compression blocks, then lightly improves contrast and brightness, then enlarges the picture with an AI model that runs on our own server. The AI result is mixed with a plain enlargement of your own picture and its overall colours are matched back to it, so invented texture stays limited and colours do not drift. The other side of the picture follows your original shape, so the aspect ratio is kept. It still cannot recover detail the camera never captured: very small faces or tiny text that are unreadable in your picture can come out soft or slightly wrong, so always check faces and text. Pictures with transparency, and pictures already at or above the size you pick, use classic sharpening instead.
good: Photos that are soft, grainy or full of JPEG blocks
Small images that need to be bigger for a screen, a print or a website
Profile photos, product pictures, scans and screenshots where faces, colours and text must stay true
limits: Not a miracle for badly out-of-focus pictures or tiny thumbnails
Faces smaller than about 100 pixels and tiny text can stay soft or change slightly: check them
Transparent PNGs and pictures already at the chosen size use classic sharpening
privacy: Your picture is processed in memory and is not saved on our servers. We keep only a count of how many images you enhanced today, so we can apply the daily limit.

faqs.q: What does Natural pro mode do?
faqs.a: It removes grain and JPEG compression blocks, improves contrast and brightness only a little (never changing hue or colours), enlarges the picture with AI, and then lightly sharpens brightness only. It does not add, remove or redraw anything in your picture. After enhancing, the page lists what was done.

faqs.q: Will it change faces or text in my photo?
faqs.a: It is built not to: the AI result is blended with a plain enlargement of your own picture and the colours are matched back, so people and text keep their look. No AI upscaler is perfect, though. Very small faces and tiny text can come out soft or slightly different, so compare with the slider and use the Light strength if a face looks off.

It makes soft and small pictures much clearer, but no tool can fully reverse heavy blur from missed focus or motion. The AI model sharpens edges and adds believable texture; it cannot know the true detail that was never captured.

Yes, for pictures that need enlarging: a small Real-ESRGAN model runs on our server. In Natural pro mode its result is mixed with a plain enlargement of your own picture and the colours are matched back to it, which keeps the look natural. It is slower than plain resizing (a 4K result takes roughly 10 seconds). Transparent images and pictures already at the chosen size use classic Lanczos sharpening.

The long edge of the result is 2560, 3840 or 7680 pixels, and the other side follows your picture's shape, so the aspect ratio is kept. A landscape 16:9 photo becomes 3840 x 2160 at 4K. If your image is already at or above the size you choose, it keeps its size and is only cleaned and sharpened.
No. The image is handled in memory during the request and is not written to disk or the database. Only a daily usage count is kept.

faqs.q: Why do I have to sign in?
faqs.a: Enlarging to 4K and 8K uses a lot of server power. A free account lets us apply a fair daily limit and keep the tool available for everyone.

faqs.q: Which file types and sizes work?
faqs.a: JPG, PNG and WebP, up to 15 MB and about 50 megapixels. Choose JPG or WebP for 8K, because 8K PNG files are very large.

faqs.q: Which output format should I choose?
faqs.a: JPG is the smallest and works everywhere. PNG keeps transparency and is lossless but large. WebP is small and keeps transparency, and is supported by modern browsers.
